items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Also here is Ken, Kennith Kimery- with an “i”- from the Smithsonian Institution. He’s doing sound and video, and Jimmy Owens.

ctx.x: This is the Smithsonian Institution isn’t it? I thought so.
So, you did Tom McIntosh? Kennith Kimery: I’m waiting; Tom is supposed to be in town for a recording session. We are trying to coordinate it.
Recording sessions can be far off Kennith Kimery: Yeah, he put me in touch so I have to call him when I get back. We’ll see.
